description: This file defines the StoriesListener class, a component that listens for story-related model events (create, update, delete) in the Goteo application. It handles creating feed entries when stories are updated or deleted.

classes.name: StoriesListener
classes.description: A listener class for handling story-related events such as creation, update, and deletion, and generating feed entries accordingly.

methods.name: createFeed
methods.description: Generates a feed entry when a new story is created or updated, including user and image context.

methods.name: onStoryUpdated
methods.description: Handles the event when a story is created or updated, and triggers feed creation if active.

methods.name: onStoryDeleted
methods.description: Handles deletion of a story and generates a corresponding feed entry.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of model events that this listener subscribes to: created, updated, and deleted events for stories.
